item.title: Dog poo and litter, 21st August
item.description:
I am writing to raise a complaint about the ongoing issue of **dog poo and litter being left on the road** in the area. The amount of rubbish and dog fouling is creating an unpleasant and unhygienic environment for residents and visitors. It is particularly concerning as people, children and animals are having to walk around and potentially come into contact with the waste. In addition to being unsightly, the litter can attract pests, block drains and cause environmental damage, while dog fouling presents an obvious hygiene and public health concern. I would appreciate it if the council could investigate this issue and arrange for the area to be cleaned as soon as possible. I would also ask that appropriate measures are considered to prevent this from continuing, including increased street cleaning, monitoring and enforcement where necessary. Please confirm that this complaint has been received and let me know what action will be taken to address the issue. Thank you.

Nearest road to the pin placed on the map (automatically generated by OpenStreetMap): Regal Row, Nunhead, Greater London
Report on FixMyStreet
